name: Canada PBR certificate 7211
description: Canadian plant breeders' rights certificate 7211 for the blueberry variety 'DrisBlueTwentyThree', trade name Rosita, application 20-10341. Grant of rights 1 November 2024. The examination was a comparative trial run by Expert Agriculture Team Ltd. at Chilliwack, British Columbia in the 2023 growing season, using a randomised complete block design of four replicates of three plants per variety.

attributes.trial_design: randomised complete block, 4 replicates x 3 plants per variety, measurements from 10 plants; 1-year-old plants transplanted April 2021 into raised beds with plastic mulch and drip irrigation; 90 cm in-row, 3 m between rows
attributes.parentage: '196H-3' x '75J301', crossed February 2011 in Santa Cruz County, California, selected April 2013 in Hillsborough County, Florida
